acceptanceCriteria.text: Both queues refresh an open game tab after60seconds stalled following prior completion, with visible recovery/failure logs.
Progress, disabled/empty queues and absent game tabs never cause unwanted refresh; concurrent queues cannot repeatedly reload the same game tab; pending items are retained until server confirmation.
Regression tests, typecheck and production build pass; docs and versioned release are committed.

checkpointPayload.description: Automatically refresh an existing game tab when Building or Research cannot start the next queued upgrade within60seconds of the previous upgrade ending. Preserve RPC confirmation, queue items and shared dispatch settings; bound reloads and log recovery.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Add persisted completion-to-next-start watchdog to shared city queue runner. Detect known finish/confirmed completion or transition to idle; reload an existing game tab once after60s, coordinating both queues and retaining pending state for authoritative reconciliation. 2. Cover timeout boundaries, no tab, disabled/empty queues and RPC policy, progress, failure and shared reload suppression. 3. Update reconciliation docs, version/changelog/build and commit.
